import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0157 (x y : ℝ) : sin (cos x + cos y) = cos (sin x + sin y) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0157 (x y : ℝ) : sin (cos x + cos y) = cos (sin x + sin y) := by
  have h1 : cos x + cos y = sin x + sin y := by
    rw [cos_add, sin_add]
    ring
  have h2 : sin (cos x + cos y) = cos (sin x + sin y) := by
    rw [h1, sin_eq_cos_pi_div_two_sub, cos_eq_sin_pi_div_two_sub]
    ring
  exact h2
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0157 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0157 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
